build.beforeDevCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173; else npm --prefix ../frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173; fi
build.beforeBuildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then npm --prefix frontend run build; else npm --prefix ../frontend run build; fi
